description: This file defines the NewsArticle class, which models a news article with a headline and HTML body generated with a nonsense text generator. It includes methods to create a new article, retrieve the headline, and retrieve the body.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: Represents a news article with a headline and body, where the body is generated with HTML markup and contains placeholder nonsense text.

methods.name: NewsArticle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a news article with a generated headline and body composed of multiple paragraphs of nonsense text.

methods.name: getHeadline
methods.description: Returns the headline of the news article.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the HTML-formatted body of the news article.
